_doc: Module 4 leads that exist only in this module. The five course buyers come from scorm-shell/data/sample-profiles.json. Each lead here looks like a real buyer on one signal and misses on another field. reference holds the score on the module scale; the solo task accepts a total within 2 points with the same decision.

leads.name: R.B.
leads.stage: Series-C · CFO leads a buying committee

reference.why: The Series C makes Helio Rivers look like a hot lead. With 180 people and a CFO who buys through a committee it is outside SMB: size and decision-maker both score 1, and the total is 16. It goes to the mid-market team.

Food service with one site scores 4 on industry, and you would be talking to the founder. But €6K a month is below the €10K floor, and the only signal is a routine filing. The total is 16, so you skip it.

signals.content: Annual accounts — flat year on year, 1 site only.

reference.why: Wholesale with one site, 38 people, €22K a month and the owner on the phone add up to 19. Flat accounts and no visible pain make intent the weak spot, and the lead goes on this week's list.
